### What ".25 BHK" Means
- The ".25" in 2.25 BHK and 3.25 BHK refers to a **dedicated Smart Study / Work-from-Home pod** — an ergonomically isolated, acoustically private room designed for remote/hybrid work professionals
- This is NOT a store room or utility space — it is a full enclosed room with window, ventilation, and electrical provisions
- This unique configuration is specific to Krisala Aventis Tathawade and sets it apart from standard 2 BHK or 3 BHK apartments in West Pune

## 4. Construction Technology & Structural Specifications

- **Construction Technology**: 100% Monolithic Aluform (Aluminium Formwork) — German engineering
- **Structural Grade**: Earthquake Resistant (IS:1893 Zone III compliant, highest category for Pune)
- **Benefits vs. Conventional Brick-Mortar**:
  - Zero construction joint seepage (monolithic pour — walls + slab cast simultaneously)
  - High tensile shear walls (superior seismic performance)
  - Maximized interior carpet area efficiency (no thick brick columns)
  - Laser-straight wall and ceiling finishes (no plaster needed)
  - 30–40% faster construction cycle (critical for Dec 2026 possession)
  - Lower long-term maintenance costs (no plaster cracks, no seepage)
- **External Finishes**: Premium weather-proof exterior paint; double-glazed powder-coated aluminum windows; anti-skid vitrified tile flooring
- **Kitchen**: Granite counter tops; Jaguar/Kohler CP fittings; modular-ready provisions
- **Electrical**: Legrand/Schneider modular switches; 3-phase power supply; 24/7 power backup for common areas; EV charging conduit in parking
